VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence is insufficient to verify acceptance criterion (1). The CI log and package.json diff confirm tests pass and no new dependencies were added, but there is **no code diff showing the actual fix** to the stale-quote eviction logic. "All tests pass" only proves the bug is fixed if a test specifically reproduces the stale-quote eviction bug—and no such test is shown to exist or to have been added. The agent could have made tests pass without actually addressing the eviction bug, or the bug may not be covered by any test at all.

To flip this to PASS, I'd need: (a) the code diff showing the eviction guard, and (b) a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after.
